command: set -euo pipefail; ruby -ryaml -e 'YAML.load_file(".github/workflows/ci.yml"); puts "yaml ok"'; grep -q 'run: ./mvnw -q -T1C verify org.jacoco:jacoco-maven-plugin:report' .github/workflows/ci.yml; grep -q '<jacoco.version>0.8.16</jacoco.version>' pom.xml; grep -q 'org.jacoco:jacoco-maven-plugin:report' docs/RUNBOOK.md; grep -q 'NoPluginFoundForPrefixException' docs/RUNBOOK.md; grep -q 'jacoco.version' docs/RUNBOOK.md; grep -q '### 10.5 并行/多 fork 与首响应闸门约定' docs/CODING-STANDARDS.md; grep -q 'stream_defaultTextPlan_firstResponseCarriesFirstTextChunk' docs/CODING-STANDARDS.md; grep -q 'forkCount=1' docs/CODING-STANDARDS.md; grep -q 'ModelRegistryIntegrationTest' docs/CODING-STANDARDS.md; grep -q 'holdAfterFirstContent' docs/CODING-STANDARDS.md; grep -q 'test: "./mvnw -q -T1C verify jacoco:report && pnpm -w test -- --coverage"' AGENTS.md; grep -q 'coverage: "./mvnw -q -T1C verify jacoco:report && pnpm -w test -- --coverage"' AGENTS.md; ./mvnw -q -pl apps/worker help:effective-pom -Doutput="$TMPDIR/m22-verify-eff.xml"; grep -q '<version>3.5.6</version>' "$TMPDIR/m22-verify-eff.xml"; test "$(grep -c 'uses: actions/checkout@v7' .github/workflows/ci.yml)" -eq 6; test "$(grep -c 'uses: actions/setup-java@v6' .github/workflows/ci.yml)" -eq 4; test "$(grep -c 'uses: actions/setup-node@v7' .github/workflows/ci.yml)" -eq 4; test "$(grep -c 'uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7' .github/workflows/ci.yml)" -eq 5; test "$(grep -c 'uses: actions/download-artifact@v8' .github/workflows/ci.yml)" -eq 1; test "$(grep -c 'uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6' .github/workflows/ci.yml)" -eq 1; test "$(awk '/uses: pnpm\/action-setup@v6/{print NR; exit}' .github/workflows/ci.yml)" -lt "$(awk '/uses: actions\/setup-node@v7/{print NR; exit}' .github/workflows/ci.yml)"; if grep -Eq 'checkout@v[0-6]|setup-java@v[0-5]|setup-node@v[0-6]|upload-artifact@v[0-6]|download-artifact@v[0-7]|action-setup@v[0-5]' .github/workflows/ci.yml; then exit 1; fi; test -z "$(git diff --name-only bd39cd6638591d8b8c0d4cdde47950d29f6147d3..HEAD -- AGENTS.md apps/api/src/main apps/worker/src/main apps/web/src pom.xml contracts deploy)"; git diff --check
note: M22 verifier 文档/合同一致性：CI 全限定 goal 与 RUNBOOK 一致、根 pom jacoco 0.8.16、Actions 主版本/顺序、CODING-STANDARDS §10.5、AGENTS 合同文本未改、产品源码零 diff
